note: List as reported at launch (19 November 2026) from the PS5 trophy data via Exophase and the Xbox achievement list. Rockstar, Sony and Microsoft have not published an official list. The Chapter 2 trophy name is printed censored by the reporting sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. It is not a task — it is the reward for the whole list, so treat it as a progress meter, not a job.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work you do earlier still counts. It is a 35-task list: all story missions, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 39 illegal operations, 8 bank vaults, and more. Budget the last 40-50 hours for this alone.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300. Planes and fast bikes make the air stunts far easier.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two shooting ranges hold 42 gold-medal challenges between them. Learn each range's weapon pattern first with bronze runs, then chase gold — the timer is usually the real enemy, not the targets.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vault jobs unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open — bring your partner, you cannot carry all the bags alone. Five vaults for the trophy; 100% wants all eight.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only some questlines count toward the eight — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies, so they do not count here. Watch the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones register.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Cards are scattered across Leonida — shops, side activities and hidden spots. Finish any three full sets; track which sets you have started so you don't spread yourself across six half-finished ones.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app and snap the prompt at 100 spots around the map. It pairs naturally with exploring for The Goodtime State — do both on the same road trip and the count climbs fast.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types in total. Just sample each one once — a race, a fishing spot, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest. Nothing needs winning here, just trying.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Twenty different race events, not twenty wins in the same one. Work through the race map event by event; the street-racing strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks too.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Easiest during a bank vault escape — a vault job hands you 4 stars immediately, and escaping one with your partner pops this too. Break line of sight, then stay out of the red heat zone until the stars fade.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Cover every named area of the map. Drive the highways between districts and the fog lifts as you go — pair it with WAiNK It stops and vehicle scanning to make the mileage count three ways.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: One illegal operation robbed from each of the nine gangs. 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way — just make sure your first nine cover nine different gangs.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and payday-loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative, so bank the bills steadily instead of spending them dirty.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen drone race locations. Win at least one race at each — learn the gates on a practice run first, then race for the win. The drones handle nothing like cars, so expect a few crashes.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Cumulative across every kind of shop. Big purchases help — vehicles, clothes, weapons — and the total climbs on its own if you shop normally through the story.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and beat his catch. Match the bait to the spot and keep the line tension in the green — reeling too hard snaps it, too soft and the fish gets away.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any arcade cabinet, any game — just finish one. The arcades are scattered around Vice City; pick the cabinet whose game you actually enjoy and play it through.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable one — read the Missables page before you finish Chapter 1. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies. Use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush an armored truck, crack it open and get clear of the heat zone. It pops once you have left the red zone, not just the flashing search area — keep driving until the stars are gone.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges live under Progress > Challenges — 80 in total across eight categories of 10. 100% needs 70, so this pops on the way. Many complete on their own while you play; check the list when you are close and mop up the easy ones.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission. Just play it — this is the first story trophy and it unlocks naturally at the end of Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before you do, make sure you have done Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — it disappears when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Character switching opens up during this chapter, so start using your partner for the duo trophies from here on. The name is printed censored by the reporting sources.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs opens jewelry robberies, and from here you can register cars at Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault jobs unlock through That's Where The Money Is near the end of this chapter — that is your route to Maximum Withdrawal and Hot Together.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, and you will want that save for cleanup and for the 100% checklist that opens after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy. It unlocks when you finish Breakfast Run — no special requirements, just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy for finishing The Cartel Heist. Bring plenty of ammo and armor — heists are where the game stops pulling punches.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy for finishing Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy for finishing Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy for finishing VCIA Takedown at the airport. Expect heavy resistance — stock up before you start.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy for finishing Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's side-story strand to its final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush — but finish them before you call the list done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's side-story strand to its final mission. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, since it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's side-story strand to its final mission. Like Billy's, Andy's strand has its own trophy and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's side-story strand to its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's side-story strand to its final mission. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine — bring a scoped rifle and take your time.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Jason and Lucia both need to reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you, so both bars climb together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just keep playing the criminal life.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Find the Ocean Beach bar spot and order a cocktail with a view. A small hidden moment — wander the beachfront until the prompt appears.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out through a vehicle showroom's frontage. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build speed inside if you can, and smash out in classic style.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A hidden moment trophy with a cryptic hint — it pops on a second attempt at something that went wrong the first time. Keep an eye out for repeatable events and try them twice.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A hidden moment trophy — something strange happens somewhere in Leonida and this pops when you see it. Explore the odd corners of the map and it will find you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock bowling pins over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle through the pins. Slow down just enough to aim, then drive through the set.
